text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I have a bit of a headache... It's
been
raining a lot lately, so it may have
something to
do with the air pressure...
choice_data_list: You look like you're not feeling well.
You seem like you're not feeling well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...No, I can't be weak! I'll break that jinx
and
cheer right—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
R-right... Ugh. Is there no way to get
ahead of
nature?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Nnng... I'm sorry, but I might go lie down
for a
bit...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't like rain to begin with, so
I'm sure the
weather is only making her
headache worse.
Hopefully it clears up
soon...
